'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[2021 Afghanistan attacks]]
***Eleven people are killed and 29 more are injured when a [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bomb]] hits a bus in [[Zabul Province]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/10/at-least-11-killed-in-afghanistan-bus-bombing (Al Jazeera)] [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-172073 (TOLO News)]
***Five members of the [[National Directorate of Security]], the head of the economy directorate of the [[provinces of Afghanistan|province]], and a manager of the Central Bank branch in [[Logar Province]] are killed in three separate incidents, all of which involved attacks by unknown gunmen. In a fourth incident in the same province, two civilians are killed and six more are wounded after two [[mortar (weapon)|mortar]] shells hit their house on Sunday evening. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-172073 (TOLO News)]
**[[Afghan peace process]]
***In the early hours, the [[Taliban]] announces a three-day [[ceasefire]] to observe the [[Eid-ul-Fitr]] holiday. A Taliban spokesman says that it is for the [[mujahideen]] to provide a peaceful and secure atmosphere to their compatriots. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/afghan-taliban-declares-three-day-ceasefire-eid-celebration-this-week-spokesman-2021-05-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Israel–Palestine crisis]]
**[[Palestinian militants|Palestinian groups]] in the [[Gaza Strip]] including [[Hamas]] fire [[List of Palestinian rocket attacks on Israel in 2021|barrages of rockets at Israeli cities and towns]] near the Gaza border, as well as seven toward Jerusalem, injuring one person. [[Israel]] retaliates with airstrikes in Gaza killing 24 people and wounding 103 others. Nine children and a Hamas leader are among the dead. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/10/palestinians-20-killed-in-fighting-including-9-children (''Al Jazeera'')]
*[[2021 Colombian protests]]
**[[President of Colombia]] [[Iván Duque Márquez]] orders a mass deployment of troops to the city of [[Cali]] and its surrounding area after 12 days of protests. [https://en.mercopress.com/2021/05/10/duque-militarizes-cali-and-neighbouring-areas-as-situation-worsens-in-colombia (MercoPress)]
**[[Human Rights Watch]] reports on the use of "horizontal high-speed multiple projectile launchers" meant to fire multiples of [[tear gas]] or [[stun grenade]]s simultaneously. The Executive Director of the Americas Division, José Miguel Vivanco, publishes a corroborating video reportedly showing a Venom grenade launcher from [[Combined Systems, Inc.|Combined Systems]] being used against protesters. [https://en.mercopress.com/2021/05/10/human-rights-watch-warns-colombian-police-uses-high-tech-projectile-launcher-against-demonstrators (MercoPress)] [https://twitter.com/JMVivancoHRW/status/1390396994804502535 (Twitter)]
*A US Coast Guard vessel fires roughly 30 warning shots on Monday to drive away Iranian fast-attack boats in an "unsafe" encounter in the Strait of Hormuz.  [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/a-us-coast-guard-ship-fired-30-warning-shots-from-a-machine-gun-during-an-unsafe-encounter-with-iranian-fast-attack-boats/ar-BB1gzXfu?ocid=uxbndlbing (MSN)]
*[[2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes|2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict]]
**Citizens who evacuated from the [[Batken Region]] due to clashes at the [[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border]] return to the area for the first time since the clashes. [https://akipress.com/news:657996:Batken_evacuees_return_home/ (AKIPress)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Chernobyl disaster]]
**[[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]] scientists report that, for an unknown reason, the levels of [[nuclear radiation]] have increased in the remains of the [[Chernobyl power plant]]. Most areas of containment have shown decreasing radiation levels, however, in one particular room, radiation counts have doubled over the last four years. These radiation levels are high enough to preclude installing sensors. Additionally, fuel containing materials, which were initially the consistency of lava, are disintegrating into radioactive dust. [https://www.popularmechanics.com/science/energy/a36364988/chernobyl-nuclear-reactions/ (''Popular Mechanics'')] [https://www.sciencemag.org/news/2021/05/nuclear-reactions-reawaken-chernobyl-reactor (''Nature'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alberta]]
*****[[Alberta]] expands its [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] eligibility to people over the age of 12 years. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7848632/alberta-covid-19-vaccine-12-or-older/ (Global News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
*****The [[Food and Drug Administration]] authorizes the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer–BioNTech vaccine]] for use in children between the ages of 12 and 15 years. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/fda-authorizes-pfizer-coronavirus-vaccine-for-adolescents-12-to-15-years-old/ar-BB1gA3P2 (MSN)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tamil Nadu]], [[COVID-19 lockdown in India]]
*****[[Tamil Nadu]] enters a two-week complete lockdown until May 24 amidst an increase in the number of [[COVID-19]] cases. [https://www.livemint.com/news/india/tamil-nadu-2-week-complete-lockdown-begins-today-11620626619021.html (Livemint)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kyrgyzstan]]
****[[Kyrgyzstan]] receives the second component of [[Russia]]'s [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[vaccine]]. [http://en.kabar.kg/news/second-component-of-sputnik-v-vaccine-delivered-to-kyrgyzstan/ (Kabar)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]], [[Malaysian movement control order]]
****[[Prime Minister of Malaysia|Prime Minister]] [[Muhyiddin Yassin]] announces a new nationwide [[COVID-19 lockdowns|movement control order]] from May 12 until June 7, with additional restrictions due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://www.malaymail.com/news/malaysia/2021/05/10/pm-announces-mco-for-whole-of-malaysia-from-thursday/1973135 (''Malay Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal]]
****[[Nepal]] reports a record 9,127 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 403,794. [https://kathmandupost.com/health/2021/05/10/nepal-records-highest-single-day-spike-with-9-127-new-covid-19-cases (''Kathmandu Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] receives its first shipment of 193,050 doses of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer–BioNTech]] [[COVID-19 vaccine]] distributed through the [[COVAX]] initiative. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/nation/786947/193k-pfizer-biontech-covid-19-vaccine-doses-arrive-in-philippines/story/ (GMA News Online)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]], [[Lineage B.1.617]]
****[[Thailand]] reports its first two cases of the Lineage B.1.617 variant in a woman and her four-year-old son who traveled from [[Pakistan]] and are currently in [[quarantine]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/indian-virus-variant-found-thai-travelers-pakistan-77600026 (ABC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reopens primary and junior high schools for in-person classes for the first time in months. The courts also restart many activities. [https://www.usnews.com/news/business/articles/2021-05-10/greece-welcomes-young-students-back-to-school-courts-reopen (U.S. News and World Report)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] surpasses 5 million cases of COVID-19, becoming the fifth country to do so after the [[United States]], [[India]], [[Brazil]], and [[France]]. [https://m.bianet.org/english/health/243817-turkey-s-coronavirus-death-toll-tops-43-thousand-cases-5-million (Bianet)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] lowers its COVID-19 Alert level to level 3 as [[COVID-19 vaccination in the United Kingdom|vaccination]]s and lockdown restrictions ease pressure on the [[NHS]], which means that the transmission of the virus is no longer rising exponentially. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/covid-vaccine-uk-alert-level-b1844864.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]], [[variants of SARS-CoV-2]]
***[[Argentina]] reports its first cases of the Lineage B.1.617 variant in two people who travelled from [[Paris]], as well as its first case of the [[Lineage B.1.351]] variant in a person who travelled from [[Spain]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentina-confirms-first-cases-covid-19-variants-india-south-africa-2021-05-10/ (Reuters)]
**[[Variants of SARS-CoV-2]]
***The [[World Health Organization]] classifies the Lineage B.1.617 variant as a "Variant of Concern", becoming the fourth variant to be designated as being of global concern after the [[Lineage B.1.1.7|B.1.1.7]], [[Lineage B.1.351|B.1.351]], and [[Lineage P.1|P.1]] variants. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/coronavirus-strain-found-in-india-is-a-variant-of-concern-who-says-11620662311 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bahrain]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Bahrain]] and the [[United Arab Emirates]] establish “a safe travel corridor” for those who have been [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccinated]] against COVID-19, which will be in effect by the end of this week. [https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2021/05/10/UAE-Bahrain-establish-safe-travel-corridor-for-vaccinated-travelers (Al-Arabiya English)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 Dunedin Countdown stabbing]]
**A man [[mass stabbing|stabs and injures four people]] in a [[Countdown (supermarket)|Countdown]] supermarket in [[Dunedin]], [[New Zealand]]. He is also injured and has been hospitalised. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-05-10/four-people-stabbed-in-new-zealand-countdown-including-staff/100128890 (ABC News)]
*A [[Judiciary of France|court]] in [[Paris]] dismisses the complaint of a [[Vietnamese people in France|French Vietnamese]] woman against several manufacturers of the [[Agent Orange]] chemical used by the [[United States Armed Forces|United States military]] during the [[Vietnam War]]. The court rules it to be a [[Sovereignty|sovereign]] case under the [[Federal judiciary of the United States|jurisdiction of the United States]] [https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/french-court-dismisses-complaint-over-agent-orange-use-in-vietnam-war-4275860.html (''VnExpress'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[Federal Parliament of Nepal]] votes 124–93 in a [[Motion of no confidence|no confidence]] vote against [[Prime Minister of Nepal|Prime Minister]] [[KP Sharma Oli]] over both his handling of the COVID-19 pandemic and his attempts to lead a [[minority government]] after his party, the [[Nepal Communist Party]], split into the [[Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Marxist–Leninist)|Communist Party of Nepal–UML]] and [[Communist Party of Nepal (Maoist Centre)|Communist Party of Nepal–Maoist]] earlier this year. [[President of Nepal|President]] [[Bidya Devi Bhandari]] is expected to name Oli caretaker Prime Minister until the next election. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/10/nepal-pm-loses-confidence-vote-amid-surging-pandemic (Al Jazeera)]

'''Science and technology'''
*Sources in Russia's defense industry report that [[Russia]] will be carrying out three tests of the [[RS-28 Sarmat]] [[hypersonic]] [[ICBM]] during the third quarter of 2021 at the [[Kura Missile Test Range]] in [[Kamchatka Krai]] as part of flight design tests. Two of the tests are expected to test maximum capabilities for the ICBM with a specified range of 18,000 km and speeds of around Mach 20, prior to final deployment with the armed forces in 2022. [https://tass.com/defense/1286447 (TASS)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Italian Football Federation]] president Gabriele Gravina threatens to expel [[Juventus F.C.|Juventus]] from [[Serie A]], the highest tier of the [[Italian football league system]], if the club does not withdraw from the proposed [[European Super League]] before the start of [[2021–22 Serie A|the next season]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/57061939 (BBC Sport)]
